headings.notes: Used for dashboard titles and widget headers. Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.

data_columns.notes: CRITICAL: Must use for all numeric columns (prices, USDT amounts, OrderIDs, Tx hashes) to ensure columnar alignment.

typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max text-5xl. H2 text-3xl. Widget headers text-sm uppercase with tracking-widest.

colors.forbidden_colors: Teal green/blue (#1B93A4) and #7351B7 are strictly forbidden.
colors.tint_rule: Tint neutral greys slightly with blue (cool) to make them feel alive.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items have subtle borders on right and bottom. 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only use for fixed headers or floating modals. backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/60, border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.transparency_rule: CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Institutional design prioritizes flat, crisp data over soft shadows. Use 1px borders instead.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6. Tight gaps (gap-4). Every pixel utilized.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense for data tables (p-2 to p-4). Generous for page wrappers (p-6 to p-8).
grids_and_layouts.order_book: Split layout. Left: TopUp (Fiat -> Crypto). Right: Redeem (Crypto -> Fiat). Dense rows.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Numeric data right-aligned. Labels and text left-aligned.
grids_and_layouts.general: Optical alignment over geometrical alignment. Mobile-first responsive.

component_strategies.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm max). Dark backgrounds for inputs with focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white.
component_strategies.tables: Dense. No card wrappers for tables if possible. Use Grid Borders style. Sticky headers.
component_strategies.buttons: Sharp corners. High contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white).
component_strategies.tabs: Minimalist underline style or sharp pill, not soft bubbles.
component_strategies.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.

motion.interactions: Fast transitions (100-150ms). opacity and color fades on hover.
motion.live_order_flow: Use Framer Motion to animate new orders entering the top of the order book (slide down + flash background color briefly).

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard. Text over gradients/images must have text-shadow.

image_urls.description: Overlapping dark grey squares forming a geometric pattern on a black background

media.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboards.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly necessary, but can use Visx or simple Recharts for the Match Detail View (Sankey/Flow) or periodic financial recap. Minimal usage to preserve institutional seriousness.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts framer-motion clsx tailwind-merge date-fns
Build a robust layout: A left sidebar (dense, dark) with routing for Dashboard Home, Order Book, Settlements, Settings.
Top header should show live Escrow Balance and active mock websocket status (e.g., 'TRON Testnet: Connected').
Order Book: Implement a dual-pane view. Left side: TopUp requests (Fiat to USDT). Right side: Redeem listings (USDT to Fiat). Use JetBrains Mono for prices.
Match Detail View: Create a visual connection component showing how a 100 USDT TopUp is split between two 50 USDT Redeem orders. Use simple HTML/SVG lines or grouped Shadcn cards.
Mock functionality: Make sure the 'Confirm IDR Received' button triggers a state change in the UI (e.g., from PARTIALLY_MATCHED to COMPLETED) and updates the ledger.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for complex/overlapping analytical layouts, falling back to Shadcn for inputs and basic tables.
NEVER use generic 'Inter' for Headings. Use IBM Plex Sans.
Javascript Environment: Create standard .js/.jsx files as typescript is not configured.
ALL interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
